INPP.name: Invoice Printed Primary
INPP.definition: Invoice printed and given to purchaser and then used for tax reclaim

INPS.name: Invoice Printed Supplimental
INPS.definition: Invoice printed but treated as supplemental because electronic copy is used for tax reclaim

INSU.name: Invoice Suppressed
INSU.definition: Printed invoice suppressed because electronic master version is used for tax reclaim

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Other tax reclaim method not elsewhere specified
